base: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game animation sprite atlas for original Blue Hour, 2:1 isometric Japanese coastal town. The input is ONLY a style/proportion/paint reference. Match its detailed softly painted low-saturation dark grey-green chibi anime game sprite treatment and soft outlines, healthy non-gory tone, no blood, no exposed wounds, no military gear, no neon. Create EXACTLY 60 distinct full-body sprites in a regular 12 COLUMN x 5 ROW grid, 3072x1280 canvas if possible. No grid lines, text, labels, scenery, shadow ovals or extra objects. Transparent padding around every sprite, feet on consistent baseline each cell, no overlap. Each row has a SINGLE camera-facing direction: row1 E right profile, row2 SE toward camera-right, row3 S front, row4 NE away camera-right (back and side visible), row5 N back. All 12 columns must retain that row direction with real perspective changes between rows (not merely rotating image). Columns: 1 neutral idle, 2 walking left foot extended, 3 walking left passing, 4 walking right foot extended, 5 walking right passing, 6 ability anticipation crouched/braced, 7 stronger ability anticipation, 8 ability release/contact, 9 ability follow-through recovery, 10 hit recoil, 11 falling/collapsing, 12 lying defeated on ground. Each is separately articulated drawing; same identity, outfit and volume throughout. Keep upper-left light, closed modest clothing.

kinds.screamer: Slim hunched infected in worn muted sea-grey long raincoat and dark daily trousers, disproportionately large head, ash short hair, pale grey-green skin, broad scarf-like throat folds. Distinctive extremely wide OPEN oval mouth with no gore and HEAD TILTED UP in anticipation and release; hands raised beside cheeks during scream. Thin angular silhouette, coat tails move in gait. NO backpack, weapons or hat.
kinds.toxic: Round pear-shaped infected in modest closed grey-green padded fisher rain jacket, small head and dark rubber boots. Distinctive two large soft inflated sage-green mist bladders at shoulders and rounded back, subtle pale fog escaping during release (inside cell). Hands brace belly in anticipation, shoulder sacs inflate then exhale in release. All surfaces intact with no wounds. Obvious huge rounded silhouette; NOT a heavy human clone.
kinds.burst: Short stocky infected in closed charcoal hooded daily raincoat, hood down, pale face and small dark boots. Distinctive asymmetrical large smooth amber-ochre glowing rounded sacs on shoulders and upper back, gentle warm light but NO neon. Swollen torso and hunched silhouette. Ability anticipation cups sacs, release arms thrown out sacs glowing with small restrained dust puffs. Defeat leaves intact body, no dismemberment.
kinds.hound: A low-slung four-legged infected dog, chibi compact head and broad paws, ragged grey-green fur, large triangular ears, small pale amber eyes, intact charcoal fur, no injuries, no collar or armor. Clearly canine quadruped in ALL cells, visible tail. Running gait alternates fore/hind paws. Anticipation crouch hindquarters loaded low ears back; release full extended airborne pounce; recovery landing forepaws. Defeated lies gently on side. Keep body broad enough for distant tactical game scale.
kinds.breacher: A massive broad-shouldered infected boss wearing a closed charcoal-grey fisher work coat, patched muted green shoulders, heavy dark gloves and rubber boots. Distinctive oversized left forearm wrapped in a bulky intact rolled grey-green padded sleeve like a blunt shield, and wide rounded collar. No weapon, armor, blood or exposed belly. A head taller and much wider silhouette than basic infected. Anticipation raises both heavy forearms, release double palm ground slam, follow through hands planted, with small dust puffs confined to cell. Head broad ash hair, tired pale face.
